title: Building – Installation of Standpipe System in Hydrocarbon Building October 2012
description: An oil sands operator planned four hydrocarbon process buildings more than 14 m high. An accredited agency ordered standpipe systems in them.

refusal.basis: not applicable: appeal of an order; the Council accepted the alternative solution

outcome_summary: Order varied: the standpipe requirement (3.2.5.8/3.2.5.9) was removed on acceptance of the alternative solution, but the 3.2.5.7 firefighting water supply and the other plans-examination requirements stand.
